chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Nu'aym ibn Ibrahim, from Misma' ibn 'Abd al-Malik, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no qisas between the free person and the slave.

key_terms.قَالَ: he said, indicating the beginning of the transmitted statement
key_terms.قِصَاصَ: retaliatory legal punishment in cases of killing or injury
key_terms.ٱلْحُرِّ: a free person, as opposed to one in bondage
key_terms.ٱلْعَبْدِ: a slave or bondsman in the legal context of the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is there qisas between a free person and a slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding qisas in cases involving a free person and a slave. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussion of retaliatory punishment and legal differentiation in homicide or bodily injury rulings.
